theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_canon_nt_exists_open_subset_measure_lt
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen W → μ W ≠ ∞ → A ⊆ W → μ A < ε → ∃ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O ∧ A ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ W ∧ μ O < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
